address_contract.upload_supported_helper_domain: 0<=x<1024 words; 0<=y<512 rows; nonnegative signed-WORD rectangle fully within those limits
address_contract.sample_offset: ordinary ((tpage&0x1f)>>1)*0x10000 + v*256 + u; alternate base offset 0x100000 when (tpage&0x180)==0x180
address_contract.clut_row_and_palette: row=(clut_word>>6)-0x1e0; row outside [0,30] becomes 0; active CC50 palette byte offset row*256+texel at absolute base 0x92C390; D420 enters CC50 only if [0x96E3E0] is nonzero and row is nonzero
address_contract.zero_texel: zero is skipped in C882/CA51/CBF4 and active CC50 palette loop. For D420 nonzero row, gate [0x96E3E0]!=0 selects CC50; gate zero selects C2E0 raw fill, including zero. Row zero branches to D60C and is outside those two routes.
